name: Tomioka Silk Mill and Related Sites
description: Tomioka Silk Mill, in Gunma Prefecture northwest of Tokyo, was built in 1872 as Japan's first large mechanized silk-reeling factory, with machinery and know-how brought from France. Three related sites complete the story of silk: a cocoon-rearing farm, a sericulture school, and a cold-storage house for silkworm eggs. Together they show how Japan became the world's top raw silk exporter.
